<noinclude>
Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Cite_web
History: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Cite_web&action=history
Revision: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Cite_web&oldid=753103437 (12/05/2016 5:36 AM UTC)
Adapted by phpBB Modders.
Changes: rewritten in plain wiki text without Lua (Module:Citation/CS1) for the common parameters, in Wikipedia's order and wording: author (or last and first), date, title linked to url (to archive-url when there is one), website or work in italics, publisher, archive-url with archive-date, access-date, and quote, in quotation marks instead of a <q> element; links with phpBB's url BBCode; no other names, editors, language, via, page, id, format or url-status options, no checking of dates or URLs and no error messages; removed the source's documentation and categories.
Example: {{Cite web|url=https://www.phpbb.com/|title=phpBB Forum Software|access-date=2026-10-14}}
Example: {{Cite web|url=https://example.com/a|title=Article|last=Smith|first=Jane|date=2025-03-04|website=Example News|publisher=Example Media|access-date=2026-10-14}}
Example: {{Cite web|url=https://example.com/b|title=Page|author=John Doe|date=March 2024|website=Example|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240501000000/https://example.com/b|archive-date=2024-05-01|access-date=2026-10-14|quote=Some words.}}
Expect: John Doe (March 2024). "Page". Example. Archived from the original on 2024-05-01. Retrieved 2026-10-14. "Some words."
Example: {{Cite web|url=https://example.com/c|title=Release notes|publisher=phpBB Limited|date=1 May 2025}}
Example: {{Cite web|url=https://example.com/d|title=Docs|last=Smith|first=Jane|work=Docs site}}
Example: {{Cite web|url=https://example.com/e|title=Ends with a question?|website=Q&A}}
